dct_title_s: Myanmar Flood Dawei: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2026
dct_description_sm: # Myanmar Flood Dawei: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2026 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Myanmar Flood Dawei (Oct 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Dawei, Myanmar, Landslide, 04 October 2026, v0.8 ** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Dawei, Myanmar, Floods, 04 October 2026, v0.8** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026)
